caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular chest with a blue frame and a yellow front panel. The front panel features three prominent circular carvings: on the left, an anchor with a rope; in the center, a spread-winged eagle with a shield on its chest (with the shield colored red, white, and blue); and on the right, the profile of a human figure wearing a cap or hood. The chest has a blue border at the top and bottom, with the lower front edge bearing the carved and painted inscription “JIM McDIVIT - GLOUCESTER” in yellow letters. The top of the chest is brown with carved blue decorations, including what appear to be anchors and other nautical elements. The side of the chest also displays a rope motif within a blue circle. The overall composition includes detailed carvings and painted highlights in blue, yellow, brown, gold, red, and white.
title: Sea Chest
